//: Typecheck config for the QueryLanguage component (#205). tsconfig.json
excludes it, because it imports the lexer and parser ANTLR generated,
and they import the antlr4 runtime, which tsc's one-file output cannot
serve. scripts/bundle-querylanguage.mjs builds it with esbuild instead.
The unused-code flags are off here only because the generated code
imports names it does not use, and it is never edited by hand. Its
stamp test fails on any hand edit.
